title: pauseWithdraw silently forfeits accrued rewards (no event, no debt rebase) and the orphaned reward share lingers in the accumulator with no on-chain redistribution semantics

knownIssueCheck.candidate: KI-4 'pauseWithdraw does NOT claim rewards or update pool (emergency exit mechanism by design)'
knownIssueCheck.rationale: The bare 'forfeit accrued rewards' aspect IS the known-issue acknowledgment. However, the finding also covers: (1) the orphaned per-share-accumulator residue with no defined redistribution semantics (value leakage to future entrants), (2) absence of a dedicated RewardsForfeited event for off-chain reconciliation, (3) the un-rebased debt that downstream causes DEDUP-002 / DEDUP-003 reverts. The downstream debt-rebase failure is NOT covered by KI-4. Per 'when in doubt, keep' rule, kept and flagged for human review at submission time. Report-writer may want to narrow the framing to the orphan-redistribution + downstream DoS angles and omit the bare forfeiture (already disclaimed).
